Solutions for Every Project HOW WE PARTNER WITH YOU Owner-centric mindset. Flexible options. Partnership starts here. We work hand in hand from day one to optimize your return on investment, understanding your vision and goals with precision. We carefully research site location and advise you on brand selection. Together, we will explore a wide range of development options, carry out comprehensive feasibility studies, and set clear performance metrics. We earn your trust through our owner-focused approach to ensure your profitability and build a relationship that lasts. Your success becomes our shared mission. 37 % Managed Hotels 60 % Franchised Hotels 50 % of projects are conversions 1st extended stay operator (outside USA) The Right Partnership Model for Every Project We bring our expertise across both management and franchise models, working closely with you to determine the optimal structure for your project based on your specific needs, brand requirements, and market opportunities. Mercure Sydney Rouse Hill, Australia Our Franchise Model You gain access to the established power of one of our brands plus comprehensive distribution, sales, marketing, and loyalty services. You access our leading procurement platform and training programs for your teams, and benefit from: Optimized visibility, enhanced sales, increased average room rates, and additional revenue; Superior marketplace dynamics and inter-hotel bookings across our network; Local expert support at every step, from brand integration to ongoing marketing. Fairmont Tokyo, JAPAN Our Management Model You gain our full operational expertise and hospitality experience to drive your performance – brand power, loyalty, sales, global distribution, and operational management – and benefit from: Local operations experts providing on-ground support and expertise; Superior marketplace dynamics and inter-hotel bookings across our network; Complete operational oversight – budgets, accounting, performance, personnel; Effective implementation of decisions made with you; Day-to-day hotel management that maximizes your profits. Our Flexible Development Options Discover our leading range of innovative development solutions and flexible property options, designed to perfectly match your project vision and investment goals. NEW BUILD CONVERSIONS BRANDED RESIDENTIAL EXTENDED STAY RESORTS MIXED USE & MULTI-BRANDED Personalized Support from the Ground Up We will help you create your unique property to achieve your specific goals, backed by the expertise of our Design & Technical Services team. From site location and brand selection to opening and beyond, our specialist teams bring their professional expertise to customize a design plan that boosts sales, increases average room rates, and generates incremental revenue. LEARN ABOUT OUR EXPERTISE Pullman Taizhou Xianju, CHINA Seamless Transformation Transform or reflag your property with flexibility and ease. With 50% of our development projects now conversions , we lead this growing market with accessible solutions designed with owners in mind. Drive revenue quickly, maintain authenticity, and align with ESG commitments through our proven conversion approach with our best-in-class conversion-friendly brands spanning all segments. With collection brands in high demand , growing about 25% per year , our unrivalled portfolio includes leading options such as Emblems, MGallery, Mondrian, TRIBE, and Handwritten Collection – these brands can help deliver a swift, accessible transformation while preserving your hotel’s unique identity and authenticity. DISCOVER OUR HOTEL BRANDS MUZE Hotel Düsseldorf Handwritten Collection, GERMANY Where Iconic Brands Meet Home Ownership As a global leader in branded residential, we offer our development partners tremendous opportunities in this increasingly in-demand market, bringing our iconic brands and quality of service to private home ownership in prime urban and resort destinations. Through Accor One Living , our industry-first 360-degree platform, we deliver full turnkey solutions for the development, design, and operation of mixed-use projects and branded homeowner communities. We unlock value - from brand premiums to supplementary revenue in F&B, spa, and coworking - significantly enhancing the economics of hotel investment. 50+ branded residence communities 180 residential projects under development 18 renowned hospitality brands, from midscale to ultra-luxury Raffles Residences Boston Back Bay, USA Maximizing an Attractive Business Model Our extended stay portfolio is the industry’s most comprehensive, with 18 brands spanning segments from market-leading Adagio to lifestyle brand Mondrian Living. It offers owners unrivaled opportunities to tap into this rapidly growing market where travelers increasingly blend business and leisure, offering an attractive business model with lower breakeven occupancies, higher operating margins, and stronger ROI. DISCOVER OUR HOTEL BRANDS The Johnson Brisbane, Art Series, AUSTRALIA All-Inclusive and Beyond Position yourself in prime resort destinations with 25+ proven brands across segments that capture growing leisure demand and provide the scale, expertise, and innovative experiences to drive your property and maximize your investment. Our expansion in resorts continues to accelerate with our All-Inclusive Collection , an industry-leading multi-branded platform offering a curated selection of resorts that redefine the guest experience. DISCOVER OUR ALL-INCLUSIVE COLLECTION Open in a new tab Rixos Premium Göcek, Türkiye Enhance Your Investment Maximize your investment through mixed-use and multi-branded developments to enhance performance. Mixed-use developments incorporate retail, coworking, F&B, residential, and more to enrich your hotel development project. Our 360-degree Accor One Living platform creates synergies between these elements to enhance financial performance through brand premiums and supplementary revenue while providing enhanced experiences for homeowners, guests, and visitors. L’avenir, c’est la franchise

Découvrez comment le modèle de franchise de Accor soutient la performance dans une ère asset-light, avec les éclairages de Leire Leoz, Directrice générale Franchise pour les marques Premium, Milieu de Gamme & Economique.

LIRE L'ARTICLE

+ 45 Brands. 5 800 Hotels.

Explorez notre portefeuille inégalé de marques hôtelières, adapté aux nouvelles manières de voyager et de vivre, couvrant tous les segments et zones géographiques et offrant des expériences diversifiées pour anticiper et répondre aux attentes des clients.

DÉCOUVREZ NOS MARQUES HÔTELIÈRES

Nous innovons dans l’hospitalité

Portés par une vision audacieuse, un esprit pionnier, une culture de l’attention et une dimension humaine, nous réinventons l’hospitalité. Découvrez notre histoire et notre manière d’accueillir - en favorisant une croissance responsable.

Découvrez qui nous sommes

Nous créons des expériences

Découvrez notre écosystème d’hospitalité diversifié – des marques de premier plan, des expériences uniques, ainsi que des solutions expertes qui réinventent l’art de voyager et génèrent de la valeur pour nos partenaires.

Découvrez nos expériences

Nous accélérons la croissance

Grâce à notre expertise renommée, notre portée internationale et notre ancrage local, nous offrons des solutions personnalisées pour accompagner le succès de nos partenaires – une référence auprès des propriétaires et investisseurs.
